LESSON: PEACEFUL CONFLICT RESOLUTION ● NEGOTIATION ● MEDIATION ● ARBITRATION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.6: Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can resolving conflicts help us live peacefully in the community?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify situations that lead to conflicts in the family
2. apply peaceful ways of resolving conflicts in the family

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify situations that lead to conflicts in the family
   In simple words: practise until you can identify situations that lead to conflicts in the family. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. apply peaceful ways of resolving conflicts in the family
   In simple words: practise until you can apply peaceful ways of resolving conflicts in the family. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration in the examples.
2. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
4. Show that you can: identify situations that lead to conflicts in the family

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Speak clearly as they discuss and present situations that may lead to conflicts in a family,
2. Work together harmoniously as they role-play peaceful ways of resolving conflicts in the family,
3. Peace: Learners resolve differences amicably when role-playing peace-building scenarios.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify situations that lead to conflicts in the family
2. apply peaceful ways of resolving conflicts in the family

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
